finding: Public benchmarks shortlist and tier the models: the mid-priced candidates sit within about 13 MMLU-Pro points. No public benchmark covers course-level ML questions in English and Persian, or extracting teaching relations (prerequisite-of, part-of, example-of), so the pilot (50 questions, ~200 gold graph facts) makes the final choice.
